intro: Free, well-maintained add-ons that most simmers start with. Everything goes in the Community folder or installs through its own official installer.

mods.name: FlyByWire Installer
mods.summary: Official installer and updater for FlyByWire aircraft and SimBridge; keeps them in sync with Sim Updates.

mods.name: FlyByWire A32NX
mods.summary: Study-level freeware A320neo with realistic systems and flight management.
mods.note: Pick the MSFS 2024 build in the installer.

mods.name: FlyByWire A380X
mods.summary: Freeware A380 from the same team, with detailed systems and cockpit.

mods.name: FlyByWire SimBridge
mods.summary: Companion app for FlyByWire aircraft: charts, terrain display and remote MCDU in your browser.

mods.name: Little Navmap
mods.summary: Free flight planner and live moving map that connects to the sim over SimConnect.

mods.name: Volanta
mods.summary: Free flight tracker and logbook with a live map and automatic flight history.

mods.name: FSLTL (FS Live Traffic Liveries)
mods.summary: Free real-world AI traffic models and liveries, with an injector for live traffic.

mods.name: vPilot (VATSIM)
mods.summary: Pilot client for flying online with live human air traffic control on VATSIM.

mods.name: FSUIPC7 (free unregistered)
mods.summary: Long-standing interface many add-ons, tools and cockpit builders depend on.
mods.note: Unregistered use is free; some features need a paid key.

mods.name: MobiFlight Connector
mods.summary: Free software for home cockpit panels, Arduino builds and StreamDeck-style inputs.

mods.name: Headwind A339X
mods.summary: Freeware A330-900neo built on FlyByWire tech. Check its site for MSFS 2024 support.
